metadata.name: tax_hook
metadata.description: An example Bordrless token hook: a programmable transfer fee paid to a collector, with a maximum wallet size. What a transfer hook on Token-2022 cannot do, in forty lines.

docs: Instructions of the example hook.

instructions.name: before_transfer
docs: `before_transfer`: the fee (one delta to the collector), and the wallet cap.

instructions.name: install
docs: Installs the hook on `mint`: the mint's hook authority signs.

accounts.name: authority
docs: The mint's hook authority; pays the rent.

instructions.name: prepare
docs: Prepares the hook for `mint`, which need not exist yet (a launch's mint: the launchpad
creates it with this program as its hook, `FLAGS` and no hook authority, from a
`LaunchConfig` that names it): the tax config and the registry, with the collector's
future holding of the mint (`holding(mint, collector)`) as the fee's destination. Create
that holding once the mint exists; transfers before that pay no fee.

accounts.name: authority
docs: Whoever prepares the hook (the launch's creator); pays the rent.

errors.name: WrongHolding
errors.msg: the holding is for another mint

errors.name: BadHookSigner
errors.msg: the hook signer is not the token program's signer for this hook

errors.name: WalletTooLarge
errors.msg: the destination would hold more than the maximum

errors.name: WrongMint
errors.msg: the arguments are for another mint

types.name: Delta
docs: One cut an answer takes from the amount.

fields.name: amount
docs: How much (above zero).

fields.name: account
docs: Index in the callback's account list (prefix first, then extras) of the holding that
receives it. Must be an extra.

types.name: HookReturn
docs: What a callback may answer in its return data. Which fields a callback may fill depends on the
callback and the flags ([`Allowed`]); the calling program refuses an answer that fills any
other field.

fields.name: deltas
docs: Cuts from the amount (the transfer; a swap's input before, its output after), at most
[`MAX_DELTAS`].

fields.name: burn
docs: Pool swap callbacks only: an amount to burn from the same side.

fields.name: lp_fee_bps
docs: `before_swap` only: the LP fee to apply instead of the pool's.

fields.name: source_hook_data
docs: Token callbacks only (`before_transfer`, `before_burn`): the source holding's new hook data
([`HOOK_DATA_LEN`] bytes).

fields.name: destination_hook_data
docs: Token callbacks only (`before_transfer`, `before_mint`): the destination holding's new hook
data.

types.name: Mint
docs: A mint. Address: any signer at creation (a keypair, or a PDA of the creating program).

fields.name: version
docs: Layout version.

fields.name: decimals
docs: Decimals.

fields.name: supply
docs: Current supply.

fields.name: max_supply
docs: Largest supply ever allowed; 0 means unlimited.

fields.name: mint_authority
docs: May mint; `None` once revoked.

fields.name: freeze_authority
docs: May freeze and thaw holdings; `None` once revoked.

fields.name: hook_authority
docs: May change the hook; `None` locks the hook for ever.

fields.name: metadata_authority
docs: May change the metadata; `None` fixes it for ever.

fields.name: hook_program
docs: The hook program, if any.

fields.name: hook_flags
docs: Which callbacks run (`bordrless_hook::token_flags`).

fields.name: name
docs: Name.

fields.name: symbol
docs: Symbol.

fields.name: uri
docs: Metadata URI.

fields.name: created_at
docs: Creation time.

fields.name: creator
docs: Who paid for the creation.

fields.name: hook_signer_bump
docs: Bump of `["hook-authority", hook_program]`, this program's signer of every callback to the
hook (one per hook program, so a hook can tell its own callbacks from a signer another hook
passed on); 0 without a hook. Set with the hook.

fields.name: reserved
docs: Reserved.

fields.name: slot_authority
docs: Hookwars: the armory's `["slots", mint]` PDA, which alone may change the slots and vote
locks; `None` when the table never changes.

fields.name: slot_count
docs: Hookwars: entries of `slots` in use (0: no slot table, the upstream single hook applies).

fields.name: slots
docs: Hookwars: the slot table, in call order; entries at `slot_count..` are zero.

types.name: Phase
docs: Before or after the operation.

types.name: Slot
docs: One slot of a mint (docs/spec/01-token-slots.md section 1.1).

fields.name: kind
docs: `bordrless_hook::slot_kind`.

fields.name: equip_rule
docs: `bordrless_hook::equip_rule` (stored, never acted on here).

fields.name: bounds
docs: Fixed bounds.

fields.name: data_offset
docs: First byte of this slot's range in `Holding.hook_data`.

fields.name: data_len
docs: Length of the range (item slots: including the epoch byte; 0 without data).

fields.name: item
docs: The equipped item (default when empty or Locked).

fields.name: program
docs: The program that runs (default when empty).

fields.name: flags
docs: Token callbacks and answers (`bordrless_hook::slot_flags`).

fields.name: pool_flags
docs: Pool slots only: the launchpad's pool flags (stored, never read here).

fields.name: equip_vault
docs: The only holding a cut of this slot may credit (default when the slot never cuts).

fields.name: signer_bump
docs: Bump of `["hook-authority", program]` under this program.

fields.name: launch_signer_bump
docs: Pool slots only: bump of the launchpad's `["hook-authority", program]`.

fields.name: data_epoch
docs: Tags this slot's data in every holding; changes on every equip; starts at 1.

fields.name: extra_count
docs: Extra accounts the item takes after its program and signer (fixed when equipped; the
Locked slot's when created). Hookwars M1: replaces the `slot_accounts` argument (M1 notes).

types.name: SlotBounds
docs: Bounds a slot keeps for life.

fields.name: max_cut_bps
docs: Most an item in this slot may cut from one transfer, in bps of the amount.

fields.name: may_refuse
docs: Whether an item may refuse operations (declared; not enforceable at run time).

fields.name: may_write_data
docs: Whether an item may write this slot's hook-data range.

fields.name: may_answer_touch
docs: Whether an item may answer `touch`.

types.name: TaxConfig
docs: The hook's settings for one mint, at `["tax", mint]`.

types.name: TokenHookArgs
docs: Arguments of a token hook callback. Balances and hook data are those of the holdings before
(`Before`) or after (`After`) the operation; `delta` is what the deltas took, known only after.

fields.name: op
docs: The operation.

fields.name: phase
docs: Before or after it.

fields.name: mint
docs: The mint.

fields.name: source
docs: Source holding (the mint for a mint).

fields.name: destination
docs: Destination holding (the mint for a burn).

fields.name: source_owner
docs: Owner of the source holding (default for a mint).

fields.name: destination_owner
docs: Owner of the destination holding (default for a burn).

fields.name: authority
docs: Who signed.

fields.name: authority_is_delegate
docs: Whether the signer acted as a delegate rather than the owner.

fields.name: amount
docs: The amount of the operation.

fields.name: delta
docs: The sum of the deltas a `before_transfer` answer took (zero before).

fields.name: source_balance
docs: Source balance.

fields.name: destination_balance
docs: Destination balance.

fields.name: decimals
docs: Decimals of the mint.

fields.name: supply
docs: Supply of the mint.

fields.name: source_hook_data
docs: The source holding's hook data (zeros for a mint).

fields.name: destination_hook_data
docs: The destination holding's hook data (zeros for a burn).

types.name: TokenOp
docs: What a token hook is being told about.
